title: Quandela, Mekdam And MEEZA Partner To Deploy Quantum Computing In The Gulf
excerpt: Quandela, Mekdam Holding Group, and MEEZA form a partnership to deploy photonic quantum computing throughout the Gulf Cooperation Council.
content:
Signed at Mobile World Congress 26 Doha, this strategic partnership combines Mekdam Holding Group Q.P.S.C. and MEEZA QSTP-LLC expertise in photonic quantum computing to meet the needs of businesses and public-sector organizations across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries. The alliance will combine photonic quantum computing expertise with Qatar’s sovereign digital infrastructure, including MEEZA’s data centers and managed services.

Photonic Quantum Computing Drives Gulf Deployment with Quandela

A Mekdam Quantum Center of Excellence will be established in Doha, specifically designed to extend its services to all Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries, positioning Qatar as a central hub for regional quantum computing expertise. This partnership builds on the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) signed between Mekdam Holding Group at the Vision Golfe forum, held in Paris in June 2026.

The alliance aims to move beyond theoretical research, focusing on the development of practical quantum applications for sectors including energy, healthcare and finance. The addition of MEEZA QSTP-LLC to the partnership is critical, enabling integration of quantum computing with Qatar’s sovereign data center infrastructure and cloud services.

This integration addresses a key requirement for sensitive industries like public administration and finance, where data security and control are paramount. “At MEEZA, our mission has always been to provide the trusted digital infrastructure that supports Qatar’s transformation,” stated a company representative, emphasizing the importance of secure, locally-hosted quantum capabilities. The collaboration will facilitate both cloud access and on-premises quantum systems, offering flexible deployment options for clients.

Bara Sami, Group General Manager of Mekdam Holding Group, described the partnership as a “decisive milestone” in the company’s commitment to strategic technologies. “Together with MEEZA, we are helping position Qatar among the first countries in the region to deploy real quantum computing capabilities, developing high-value use cases for key sectors across the Gulf and building a strong local ecosystem of expertise that will benefit Qatar for generations to come,” he said.

“With Mekdam’s regional leadership and MEEZA’s exceptional infrastructure and managed services, we have the right partners to deploy our photonic quantum technology on the ground in Qatar, from cloud access to on-premises systems.” This strategic alignment signals a deliberate effort to translate quantum potential into tangible benefits for the region’s economies and industries.

Mekdam Holding Group anticipates that this partnership will position Qatar as a regional leader in quantum technology, encouraging a local ecosystem of expertise designed for long-term benefit.
